name: 61801 · Urbana, IL
findings: ZIP 61801 (Urbana) has 143 nonprofit organizations. 91 of them (64%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 84 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 61801 (Urbana) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
91% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
